summary: Sandra (Sandy) Wolder, 62, of Aurora, CO, drowned at Upper Disaster Falls, Green River, Canyon of Lodore: the Adrift Adventures commercial raft hit a rock and flipped ~5 p.m. Friday; all occupants reached shore except Wolder; body found Sunday June 26 ~1:30 p.m. trapped underwater in the roots of a downed tree in the river
location: Upper Disaster Falls, Canyon of Lodore, Green River, Dinosaur National Monument
responding_agency: Dinosaur National Monument rangers; Moffat County Sheriff’s Office; Classic Lifeguard Air Ambulance
notes: 3-raft SAR team (2 Moffat County SO staff, 4 Dinosaur NM rangers, 1 Dinosaur River Expeditions guide); raft pinned on a rock at ~8,600 cfs, freed Saturday 6/25 with no sign of the victim; body transported by raft to Echo Park; party was 19 passengers + 5 guides [run 104] NPS Traveler article confirms Adrift Adventures oar boat flipped ~5 p.m. Friday at Upper Disaster Falls (19 passengers, 5 guides); Saturday SAR team of 3 rafts: 2 Moffat County staff, 4 Dinosaur NM rangers, 1 commercial guide; Classic Lifeguard helo searched until darkness Friday; Green River at ~8,600 cfs. Run 539: merged CPR follow-up URL (body-recovery follow-up).
